input: Draft a house rules list for new flatmates

gold.taskTitle: Draft a house rules list for new flatmates
gold.taskDescription: Create a clear, agreed-upon set of house rules to share with new flatmates moving in.

questions.title: How many flatmates will this document cover?
questions.description: Understand the size of the household to gauge how detailed and formal the rules need to be.

questions.title: When are the new flatmates actually moving in?
questions.description: Establish the deadline so the draft can be completed and shared in time.

questions.title: Which specific areas are you most concerned about?
questions.description: Identify priority topics such as cleaning, noise, guests, bills, or kitchen use.

questions.title: Should the document be casual or formally written?
questions.description: Determine the tone — a friendly welcome note versus a structured agreement-style document.

questions.title: Will flatmates be asked to sign or just acknowledge it?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a binding agreement or an informal shared reference.

questions.title: Are there any existing rules or past pain points to include?
questions.description: Surface specific issues from previous living situations that must be addressed explicitly.

questions.title: Will you draft this alone or collaboratively with flatmates?
questions.description: Determine whether input from all flatmates is needed before finalising the list.
